moves.comment: The strongest continuation is 12.Nh4, which holds the balance (+0.16, Stockfish:16) along [pv:Nh4 Rf7 O-O Nb6 Nxb6], steering toward a line where Black's pawn structure may weaken—doubled, isolated, and backward pawns that can leave Black with doubled b-pawns and lasting structural targets. O-O leads to equality and remains a comparable alternative [pv:O-O Nb6 Nh4 Rf7 Nxb6], but Nh4 is the more precise way to keep the position level.
